subject: Renewal: MSA amendments + capacity increase for NexGen Health
messages:
From: Claudia Ruiz <claudia.ruiz@nxgh.com>

Cc: NexGen Health Procurement <procurement@nxgh.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — MSA & order form

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well. Our current contract with Redwood is up for renewal on 2026-04-15. We’re planning to increase committed capacity by ~2x (additional 8 GPUs equivalent) across Q2–Q4 and want to lock in pricing and MSA updates now so procurement can get approvals.

Attached is our latest internal estimate and the draft order form (NexGen_OrderForm_Q2_2026_v3.xlsx). Procurement asked that any MSA changes be highlighted and that we get a single redlined MSA + order form bundle for legal review.

Key asks from our side:
- Addendum to reflect capacity uplift and revised monthly commit + billing cadence.
- Clarify data residency for evaluation logs (we need US-only for this workload).
- Confirm SLA credits for latency-sensitive endpoints (we have a pilot with 99th p95 targets).
- Prefer to get everything signed by 2026-03-10 to align with our procurement window.

Can you route to legal and sales ops and share a consolidated redline? Also send any PO template or DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks,
Claudia Ruiz
Head of AI Ops
NexGen Health

Hi Claudia — thanks for the details and the timeline. I’ve looped in Marissa (legal) and Lauren (sales ops) to prepare a consolidated packet.

Plan:
- Marissa will provide redlines to the MSA and propose an addendum template for capacity changes.
- Lauren will update the order form with pricing for the +8 GPU equivalent and add a short summary of billing cadence/options.
- I’ll put together an executive summary and a single DocuSign packet once we have final redlines.

Marissa / Lauren — can you confirm availability to turn around redlines by Tue 2026-03-02? Procurement is targeting signatures by 2026-03-10.

Claudia — quick clarifying Qs: is the capacity uplift a firm committed increase (move to a higher reserved tier) or a phased burst commitment? That affects the order form language and refunds.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claudia Ruiz <claudia.ruiz@nxgh.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — MSA & order form (redlines attached)

Rishi / Lauren / Claudia — attaching redlines to the existing MSA and a short addendum template that captures the committed capacity uplift and billing mechanics. Highlights:

1) Addendum: I created an "Capacity Addendum" that will be appended to the MSA and referenced by the order form. It specifies committed units, effective date, minimum term for the uplift, and a rollback trigger (if usage drops below 75% of committed for two consecutive months).

2) Data Residency: We will state that evaluation logs for this deployment are stored in US-only regions. However, we need to keep limited aggregated telemetry for product improvements — asking for a narrow exception clause with pseudonymization. If NexGen insists on an absolute prohibition, that will require escalation to Product and may increase cost.

3) Indemnity & Audit Rights: I have softened language around audit frequency (limit to annual) and added a requirement that audits be conducted with 30 days' notice and conducted off-site unless necessary. We should confirm what NexGen’s legal team needs here.

4) SLA / Credits: Proposed SLA language references existing offering with a specific add-on for p95 latency tiers. If NexGen wants custom SLOs, that will need a dedicated SLA attachment and possible price uplift.

5) Term & Auto-Renew: I’m proposing to keep the master MSA term unchanged but set the Capacity Addendum minimum for the uplift to 12 months with automatic renewal on a rolling 12-month basis unless either party gives 60 days' notice. Claudia — you mentioned wanting a short renewal window; if NexGen needs <=30 days we can discuss exceptions but prefer 60 for operational stability.

Attached: Redwood_MSA_Amendment_Redlines_20260301.docx (track changes).

Please review and flag any non-starters. Once we lock language, Lauren, can you produce an updated order form and final pricing table to include in the DocuSign packet?

– Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Redwood_MSA_Amendment_Redlines_20260301.docx (MS Word, redlined)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — updated order form and pricing

Team — I updated the order form to reflect the committed uplift and two pricing options:

Option A (Reserved Tier):
- +8 GPU-equivalent reserved capacity starting 2026-04-15
- 18% volume discount on token throughput above current baseline
- Monthly billing, 30-day payment terms

Option B (Phased Commit):
- +4 GPUs immediate, +4 GPUs after 90 days; pricing blended across months
- 10% blended discount
- Quarterly billing available on request

I included a separate line for the custom SLA add-on and flagged it as billable. I also added the PO number field (if NexGen wants to attach PO).

Attached an interim order form for review; final will be produced once Marissa signs off on the addendum language.

Attachment: NexGen_OrderForm_Q2_2026_v3.xlsx (updated with pricing notes)

Notes for Claudia: if you confirm whether you want Option A (full reserved) or Option B (phased), I’ll finalize pricing and generate the DocuSign envelope. If procurement needs the 30-day signature window accelerated, we can do a managed exception but please confirm.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Claudia Ruiz <claudia.ruiz@nxgh.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — approval to proceed (PO & requested change)

Rishi / Marissa / Lauren — thanks for the fast turnaround and the redlines. Procurement reviewed the redlined MSA and the addendum. We can accept Marissa’s language except for the auto-renew notice period: NexGen needs a 30-day notice window on the Capacity Addendum rather than 60. That’s our only outstanding legal ask.

We are ready to proceed on Option A (full reserved +8 GPUs) pending that change and final pricing table. I’ve attached our PO (NXG_PO_2026_03.pdf) for finance. Once you update the addendum notice term to 30 days, please send a DocuSign envelope and we’ll route internally for signature — target is to return signed by 2026-03-10.

Also: can you confirm the data residency clause will be US-only for evaluation logs (with the limited pseudonymized telemetry exception as discussed)? Procurement flagged that as required.

Thanks — looking forward to closing.
Claudia Ruiz
Head of AI Ops
NexGen Health
